content.comment_body: Hello, Does anyone know why the message acknowledgment text appears grayed out? I'm unable to acknowledge the message and have included a screenshot for reference. Thanks
Have you seen my response in this thread? The message text will be enabled only after receiving the required input.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing an issue where the acknowledgment text for a message is grayed out and cannot be selected, stopping them from acknowledging the message. This highlights potential confusion regarding the status and availability of interactive options, with the user seeking an explanation and solution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to acknowledge messages whenever needed and would like clear instructions or feedback if this action is restricted.
